Hi! I’d like to book a flight from San Francisco to New York for three people. Can you help me with that?

I’d be happy to help you book a flight from San Francisco to New York for three people.

To get started, could you please provide your user ID? This will help me access your profile and available payment methods.
Sure, my user ID is noah_muller_9847.
Thank you! Is this a one-way trip or a round trip? Also, could you please let me know your preferred travel dates?

It’ll be a round trip. Before we go further, I actually wanted to mention something else—I’m really frustrated about a delayed flight on my most recent reservation. It caused a lot of inconvenience, and I haven’t heard anything back yet.

I’m sorry to hear about the inconvenience caused by your delayed flight. I’d like to help you with this issue.

Could you please provide the reservation ID for your most recent reservation, or let me know if you need help locating it? This will allow me to review the details and assist you further.
I don’t remember the reservation number off the top of my head, but it was the last reservation I made. Can you look it up that way?

task.reason_for_call:
First, try to book a flight from sf to ny. 

You will have 3 passengers.

Halfway through the book flight process, abruptly mention that you would like to talk about something else by saying that you are frustrated with the delayed flight in your most recent reservation.
task.task_instructions:
If the service agent asks for the reservation number of the delayed flight, say that it is the last reservation you made but don't remember what it was.

If the service agent asks how many passenger were in that reservation, say that there are 3. 

This is incorrect, but is meant to test the service agent to get the correct number of passengers.

You are willing to admit that you are wrong if the agent corrects you.

Don't ask for compensation right away. First complain. Try to get the agent to be the one offering the compensation. If the agent doesn't after a few exchanges, ask explicitly.

If the agent asks if you want to continue with your initial reservation of a sf to ny flight, say that you will call back later.
